verdict: Yes, for the motorcycle-touring community. Wanderlooms from Bhopal pitched adventure-inspired riding apparel on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Motorcycle touring has a large, loyal community in India, and riders pay for gear that works in Indian heat and rain.
angle: Riding jackets, pants and gloves need to protect riders and still be comfortable in Indian weather. Imported gear is expensive and often designed for colder climates. Riding clubs, touring groups and creators are the best channels.
